purpose: Teach: ヴァン/タナ/サーキット/アロマ/ウルトラマン/エヴァ/ドス/ゴキブリ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ヴァン・ヘイレンのギターソロ聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were totally listening to Van Halen guitar solos, weren't you.
lines.style: Smirking accusatory drawl, hard lean on his name, daring him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットのタナくんって名前面白いな、桜
lines.en: And you named your pet Tana-kun — that's honestly pretty funny, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting fast, dry half-laugh in the middle, mumbled but clearly entertained ending.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、F1サーキットのゲームしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were playing that F1 circuit game again, weren't you.
lines.style: Mock-detective tone, quick pace, sharp knowing jab on the game, grin fully audible.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でアロマオイル使ったろ、桜
lines.en: Well you used aroma oil in home ec, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Lazy rising counterattack, voice cracking slightly upward on the question, holding the smirk.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ウルトラマンのフィギュア集めてたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to collect Ultraman figures. I remember.
lines.style: Delighted gotcha energy, drawing out the reveal, barely holding back a laugh.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エヴァ、つまりエヴァンゲリオンのファンだったよな、桜
lines.en: You were an Eva fan though, right — Evangelion, I mean, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual on the surface, genuine curiosity leaking through, softer questioning tail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、合唱でドスの効いた低音だったな
lines.en: Riku, that bass you did in choir was seriously deep and menacing.
lines.style: Exaggerated awe, dropping her own pitch to imitate the bass, cracking up after.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でゴキブリ駆除の話気持ち悪がってたな、桜
lines.en: And you totally freaked out during the cockroach-extermination talk in home ec, Sakura.
lines.style: Final smug jab, slowing to savor the memory, laughter breaking through the last words.
